edits.name: Realtime Colors
edits.value: Once you have a shortlist of palettes and a font pairing. Apply them to the sample page to see how they hold up together, then export the values for your build brief.

edits.name: Realtime Colors
edits.value: Closes the gap between a palette that looks good as swatches and one that works on a page. Seeing colour and type together makes contrast and hierarchy problems visible before anything is built.

edits.name: Haikei
edits.value: When a section needs a background or shape that is not a photo or an illustration. Waves, blobs, layered gradients. Match the colours to your palette and export as SVG.

edits.name: Haikei
edits.value: The quickest way to give a flat section some shape without it looking like stock. No sign-up and free in practice today. A Pro plan is announced but not yet priced, so check the cost before relying on it.
